cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want a townhouse. The Westminster account wants an address worth putting on the paperwork, and a flat doesn't qualify. Get the townhouse and they'll sit down with us. Don't, and they sign with someone who has.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Next step is a townhouse. Westminster buys from firms with stairs and a brass plate by the door. A receptionist too, if I can swing it. I can't promise the receptionist. The townhouse is the target.
